proposed_widenings.name: ApplyConditionEffect (spell Effect)
proposed_widenings.justification: The save_gate phase's onFail result is the Restrained condition, not damage. Effect = DamageEffect | NoneEffect in the spell surface; apply_condition exists only in mastery's SaveGateRiderResult, not for spells. The core mechanic of Ensnaring Strike is unrepresentable without this variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target has the Restrained condition until the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: periodic_damage OngoingOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: Ensnaring Strike deals 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of the target's turns while Restrained. OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit; neither models 'damage at start of target's turn_start_window while condition holds'. A new OngoingOperation kind is needed, or a ConditionRider shape that combines apply_condition + per-turn damage.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While Restrained, the target takes 1d6 Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime bonus_action with weapon-hit precondition
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's casting time is 'Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon.' The current bonus_action CastingTime variant carries no trigger/precondition field. Reaction has a trigger grammar; bonus_action needs an analogous optional trigger for post-hit smite-family spells.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon

proposed_widenings.name: ability_check escape dismissal
proposed_widenings.justification: The target or an adjacent creature can take an Action, make a STR (Athletics) check against the caster's spell save DC, and end the spell on success. No surface shape exists for 'action + ability_check against DC → dismiss spell'. The ability_check atom exists in v4 but there is no composition that models a player-facing dismissal check.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: size_filter on save_gate (Advantage for Large+)
proposed_widenings.justification: A Large or larger creature has Advantage on the initial STR save. No mechanism exists in the save_gate shape to apply a conditional advantage modifier based on the target's size. This is a secondary mechanic but the surface has no filter predicate on saves.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A Large or larger creature has Advantage on this save.

notes: Two hard blockers prevent honest encoding: (1) apply_condition is not a valid Effect in spell ActivationPhase — it only exists in mastery's SaveGateRiderResult; (2) no OngoingOperation shape models periodic per-turn damage while a condition holds. The bonus-action-with-weapon-hit-precondition is a third blocker (CastingTime has no trigger field for bonus_action). All gaps are surface_widening rather than structural_widening — the spell kind and save_gate / ongoing_effect families exist, but the Effect union and OngoingOperation union need new variants. The slot-scaled damage (+1d6 per slot above 1) would be expressible as linear_per_level axis=slot once the other gaps are resolved.
